limitations: Fixed positive translational diffusion, complete state renewal, fixed velocity-redraw law with finite Gaussian exponential moments, fixed interior initial position; no simultaneous singular limits.
scientific_integrity: The constant-drift resolvent and a pathwise reflection sandwich yield the asymptotic analytically. Finite arithmetic tests are corroborative only. Generic first-passage renewal identities and frequent-reset limit theory are prior work; only the colored-propulsion protocol prefactor is assessed here. Independent audit not performed.
title: Protocol-dependent prefactor for strongly reset active Ornstein–Uhlenbeck search
